meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把长文备忘压缩成极简短句，保留原文备份，节省 AI 输入开销。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常把冗长笔记喂给 AI，希望它只读精简版本。
copy.tagline_en: Shorten long notes into terse text to save AI tokens; keep a readable backup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often feed lengthy notes to AI and want a concise version to use.

howto.what: 把 CLAUDE.md、待办列表这类文字文件压缩成简短口语的 caveman 格式,压缩版覆盖原文件,并在系统数据目录留一份可读备份,减少输入 token。
howto.when: 当你说“/caveman-compress 文件路径”这个命令,或者用普通话说想压缩记忆/待办文件时触发。

say.text: 把 CLAUDE.md 压缩成 caveman 格式
say.note: 压缩后覆盖原文件,原版备份到系统数据目录

say.text: 压缩我的 todo 列表,别弄丢原文
say.note: 先备份到数据目录,再覆盖原文件

say.text: 把 preferences.md 也压缩了吧

howto.what_en: Compresses natural-language files (e.g. CLAUDE.md, todo lists) into terse caveman-style wording, overwrites the original, and stores a readable backup outside the source directory to reduce input token usage.
howto.when_en: Triggered by a /caveman-compress <filepath> command or whenever the user asks to compress a memory file.

say_en.note: Overwrites original after backing it up.

say_en.text: Compress my todo list, keep the original safe.
say_en.note: Backup goes to data dir, then overwrite.
